##### Project general facts

Fala by Kasco is a waterfront residential tower designed around the water beside it. Its wave-inspired architecture brings movement to the façade through flowing lines and curved terraces, while generous glazing and open balconies draw natural light and water views into the homes. The building offers studios, one-bedroom apartments and two- and three-bedroom plus layouts, alongside retail spaces. Selected ground-floor residences open onto private terraces with their own pools.

Wellness and leisure are woven into everyday life at Fala by Kasco. A rooftop swimming pool looks out over the city, joined by a fully equipped gym, a dedicated yoga area and a sauna for restoration. Social life is supported by a clubhouse, a rooftop lounge, a sunken lounge, outdoor seating and a BBQ zone, while an open-air cinema adds an evening destination and a co-working space allows residents to work without leaving home. Landscaped outdoor spaces soften the building and create quiet corners to slow down.

The interiors follow a palette drawn from the water: soft neutrals, layered textures, warm materials and subtle blue accents create calm, contemporary spaces. Bathrooms combine natural materials, sculptural details and warm lighting. Residences are delivered without furniture, leaving owners free to shape each home to their own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf Waterfront stretches along the Dubai Creek between Dubai Healthcare City and the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, combining a genuine water-facing setting with a central position in the city. The district is known for its cultural character, with Culture Village, the Mohammed Bin Rashid Library and the Jameel Arts Centre all close by, and the creek promenade offering open views towards Dubai Creek Harbour and the Downtown skyline.

Getting around is straightforward: the Al Jaddaf Metro Station on the Green Line connects the area with Deira, Bur Dubai and the rest of the network, while Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road link it with Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and the coast. Dubai International Airport, Dubai Festival City Mall, Dubai Creek Golf and Yacht Club and the clinics of Dubai Healthcare City are all a short drive away, and the Dubai Water Canal and the beaches of Jumeirah are within easy reach.

Al Jaddaf Waterfront appeals to professionals working in the city centre, healthcare staff and families looking for a calmer waterfront address close to the main business districts, which supports steady rental demand. Freehold ownership is available to international buyers, and the mix of waterfront living, culture and connectivity positions the district as a well-connected alternative to the busier central areas.
